name: GLiDE 27B

lineage.how_derived: decision model with a 255-way readout head; probabilities for every option in one forward pass

purpose: Classification, routing and scoring as typed decisions over text, JSON and images through the System One format; also sold as a hosted API (card).

license.name: Fastino Community License
license.notes: LICENSE read: free to use, but an entity with more than 10M USD annual revenue (with affiliates) that uses it in Production for any Commercial Use needs a separate written commercial agreement; commercial use must display 'Built with Fastino GLiDE'; production is any deployment serving users or supporting business operations, including internal tools, free of charge; Qwen3.8 base remains Apache-2.0. Verdict policy (README, 2026-11-19): this licence term does not lower tona_fit; kept here for an installer label.

architecture.kind: Qwen3.8-27B vision-language backbone with a 255-way readout (2.6 MB); linear-attention layers need flash-linear-attention for speed
architecture.why_this_design: not stated beyond one forward pass per question

variants.notes: 51.2 GB language model, 0.92 GB vision encoder; card says one GPU with 80 GB or more

pc-12gb.notes: 52.2 GB against a VRAM budget of 9.6 GB (VRAM minus about 2.4 GB), KV cache not included

pc-16gb.notes: 52.2 GB against a VRAM budget of 13.6 GB (VRAM minus about 2.4 GB), KV cache not included

pc-24gb.notes: 52.2 GB against a VRAM budget of 21.6 GB (VRAM minus about 2.4 GB), KV cache not included

pc-32gb.notes: 52.2 GB against a VRAM budget of 29.6 GB (VRAM minus about 2.4 GB), KV cache not included

mac-16-24gb.notes: 52.2 GB against a GPU share of about 12 GB (KV cache not included)

mac-32gb.notes: 52.2 GB against a GPU share of about 22 GB (KV cache not included)

mac-64gb+.notes: 52.2 GB against a GPU share of about 52 GB (KV cache not included)

other: transformers with the repo's glide package

benchmarks.name: Decision Index 0.3.1 public suite
benchmarks.variant: BF16, official kit, one RTX PRO 6000

strengths: A decision model reads a state (text, JSON, images) and a schema of typed questions and returns calibrated probabilities for every option in one forward pass; it does not generate text.
weaknesses: 52 GB BF16 and a revenue-capped licence with attribution duty
up to 40,000 tokens per question prompt by default
soft.maturity: vendor with hosted service; 3.6k downloads, 102 likes

tona_fit.reason: Larger than any consumer class in BF16 and no quantization is published, with the same class limits as other decision models; the alternatives (jev-27b-vl, xing-vl2.0-decision, clef) are smaller.

open_questions: Decision Index placement on the independent vision board
